notes:
- **A9 Voice can run from a Microsoft Store package.** The program is the same one; it notices when it runs from the package. A Store copy is updated by the Store, so it makes no update checks and Settings › General › Updates just says "Updates come from the Microsoft Store.". **Start with Windows** uses Windows' own startup setting for apps, and a Store copy keeps its files in the package's private folder, so it does not share notes with a copy installed from a9voice.com. If both are installed, A9 Voice tells you once. Nothing changes for the version from a9voice.com. See [The Microsoft Store copy](/docs/updates-and-channels/#the-microsoft-store-copy).
- **Connecting Claude Desktop from a Store copy is by hand.** The Store keeps a copy from changing another app's settings file, so Connectors shows the entry to paste instead of **Connect**. See [Connector for AI apps](/docs/connector/#a-microsoft-store-copy).
